Hyperfocal Distance - Simple DoF Calculator is a super simple calculator that allows photographers to easily calculate the hyperfocal distance.

To use Hyperfocal Distance - Simple DoF Calculator, simply enter your aperture (f/stop), focal length, and then either select the full frame option or enter your camera's sensor width and sensor height. Once all those values are entered, the hyperfocal distance will show.

A diagram at the bottom will clearly display the values so that there is no confusion for new photographers. 

Hyperfocal Distance - Simple DoF Calculator offers 4 camera slots so you can easily save multiple settings for quick access. There is also an option to switch between feet/inches and meters.
